A.notes: Says the passages hold nothing relevant, yet it was sent S9E18 sc.22 (Brian, the fired crew guy), S6E15 sc.8-9 (Jo Bennett) and S9E13 (Mose), all usable candidates; no position.

B.notes: Picks Charles Miner with the right impact (Michael quits, Michael Scott Paper Company) and a Jo Bennett counterpoint; minor slips (six episodes rather than seven, Jo's screen time, Prince Family padding, loose citation of S6E15 sc.9).

C.notes: The pick rests on 'BFD. Engaged ain't married. Never, ever, ever give up.' attributed to Captain Jack, but S2E11 sc.37 gives it to Michael, so the claimed impact is invented; the Ed Truck second candidate is accurate (S2E14, death S3E4).

D.notes: Quotes are accurate (S3E5 sc.28, S9E13 sc.22-23), but the pick of Mose is conceded to have 'negligible' practical impact, and the Brian evidence it was sent shows only a mention; the better candidates' scenes were not sent.

E.notes: Picks Brian (a reference candidate, breaks the documentary wall, S9E12 sc.50) with a fair counterpoint, but support is almost all memory, it overclaims that Brian 'created the central marital conflict' and garbles Hunter's song.
